title: Partnerships/Marketplace Daily Notes & Integration TODOs
content:
Daily scratchpad  quick capture for partner onboarding / integration reminders

2026-03-04 (last sync)
- Quick wins: sandbox credentials created for AcmeMarketplace (sandbox-acme-2026). Confirmed with engineering.
- Ask from Acme: SSO + Role mapping doc + example SCIM payload. Need to send by EOD Wed.

TODAY
- Priorities:
  - [ ] Send SSO/SCIM example + mapping to Acme (owner: Jordan) \u2014 target 2026-03-04 EOD
  - [ ] Confirm billing/pricing tier for pilot (owner: Aisha) \u2014 need pricing decision before contract signature
  - [ ] Integration smoke test results from infra (owner: Samir) \u2014 blocker: rate-limit headers missing from sandbox
  - [ ] Draft partner success checklist for internal handoff (owner: Jordan)

Meeting notes (2026-03-03 partner call)
- Attendees: Jordan (Redwood), Aisha (Redwood PM), Rahul (Acme eng), Priya (Acme product)
- Agenda: onboarding timeline, sandbox access, SSO, initial billing estimate
- Action items:
  - Rahul to share sample SCIM user payload and attribute map by Mon (PRT-342) \u2014 he said Tue/Wed latest
  - Redwood to provide SSO quickstart (SAML + Okta example) \u2014 Jordan to assemble
  - Legal to kick off NDAs / data processing addendum \u2014 linked: PRT-358 (Aisha owning)
  - Decide pilot pricing: propose credits-based model vs commit-based \u2014 Aisha to propose 2 options

Integration checklist (rough \u2014 to formalize)
- Pre-onboarding
  - [x] NDA sent
  - [x] Sandbox account created (sandbox-acme-2026)
  - [ ] Legal: DPA in review
  - [ ] Billing: provisional pricing agreed
  - [ ] Engineering: provide API key rotation docs, rate limits, quota policy

- SSO / Access
  - [ ] Provide SAML metadata and example assertion (Jordan)
  - [ ] Provide SCIM payload and mapping (Acme)
  - [ ] Test user provisioning flow (Samir)
  - [ ] Role mapping doc + default roles (Jordan)

- Integration testing
  - [ ] Run end-to-end request with sample prompts (integration job #47) \u2014 note: need rate-limit header fix in sandbox
  - [ ] Verify logs show request_id and token breakdown (obs team)
  - [ ] Latency test at 95th p50/p95 numbers for pilot route (target p95 < 250ms)

- Ops / Support handoff
  - [ ] Create runbook for common failures (401/403 auth, 429 rate-limit, 5xx) \u2014 assign to SRE liaison
  - [ ] Slack channel: #partners-acme (requested) \u2014 create and invite Acme reps + AE + PM

Notes / open questions
- How many seat licenses will Acme want initially? They mentioned 3-5 teams but not sure of scale. Impacts pricing.
- Do we need to provision a dedicated route for them during pilot? Might help latency but increases operational overhead. Discuss with infra.
- Sandbox missing X-RateLimit headers from gateway; need to file infra ticket (blocking smoke tests).

Quick links & refs
- Internal onboarding doc (draft): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRT/pages/123456789/Partner+Onboarding
- Jira: PRT-342 (SCIM), PRT-358 (Legal/DPA), INF-204 (sandbox rate-limit)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integration/pull/47 (integration test harness)

Notes to self
- Keep partner messaging simple: focus on "fast pilot, measurable SLOs, pricing flexibility"
- Reuse SAML quickstart from Brightco partner (copy/paste, update org names)
- Remind Aisha to include estimated cost per 1M tokens in pitch

Tomorrow (2026-03-05) rough plan
- Follow up with Rahul if SCIM not received by morning
- Finalize SSO quickstart and circulate for internal review (Aisha + Samir)
- Draft initial pilot agreement bullets for legal review

--
Personal scratch / shorthand:
- if legal stalls >3 days, escalate to VP Partnerships (Lena)
- keep a note of latency baseline before enabling any dedicated routes
- check marketplace listing template \u2014 need 1-2 screenshots + 50-word blurb from product

End of notes.
